name: Whoisology
tagline: Billions of archived domain name whois records searchable and cross-referenced for reverse lookups
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on domain registrar data availability and accuracy
Regulatory changes to WHOIS data accessibility
documented_limitations: Data updated only every few months, not real-time
Does not provide current domain ownership lookup functionality
failure_modes: Data staleness due to infrequent updates
Potential privacy concerns regarding aggregated WHOIS data visibility
controversies: Site acknowledges some users find aggregated WHOIS data visibility concerning
legal_regulatory_issues: GDPR compliance concerns regarding WHOIS data aggregation and visibility
ICANN WHOIS policy changes affecting data availability
